Name: RevenueRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RevenueRollup, command: many)
SELECT region, city, GROUPING(region, city) AS level, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS sales
FROM sales
GROUP BY region, city WITH ROLLUP;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:region⟩, ⟨c1:city⟩, ⟨c2 aliased:GROUPING(region, city)⟩ AS level, ⟨c3 aliased:SUM(amount)⟩ AS revenue, ⟨c4 aliased:COUNT(*)⟩ AS sales\nFROM sales\nGROUP BY region, city WITH ROLLUP;

Name: MonthlyRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: MonthlyRollup, command: many)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sold_on, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY month WITH ROLLUP;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:DATE_FORMAT(sold_on, '%Y-%m')⟩ AS month, ⟨c1 aliased:SUM(amount)⟩ AS revenue\nFROM sales\nGROUP BY month WITH ROLLUP;

Name: PositionalRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: PositionalRollup, command: many)
SELECT UPPER(region) AS area, COUNT(*) AS sales
FROM sales
GROUP BY 1 WITH ROLLUP;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:UPPER(region)⟩ AS area, ⟨c1 aliased:COUNT(*)⟩ AS sales\nFROM sales\nGROUP BY 1 WITH ROLLUP;
